title: Pattern Train
shareTitle: Pattern Train — Build the Pattern, Power the Train!
description: Load painted wooden shape and action patterns, send the toy train rolling, and build a five-wagon pattern of your own.
learningGoals: Recognize and extend AB, AAB, ABB, and ABC repeating patterns
Connect visual sequences with spoken words, sounds, and body actions
Plan, replay, and revise a self-chosen five-part pattern
interactionModel: tap or drag one of three large wooden tokens into the glowing final wagon; in free play, fill or replace any of five wagons and blow the whistle to replay the pattern
feedbackModel: correct cargo seats with a clack, sparkles, plays the full sequence left to right, and powers a readable train roll; misses wobble gently and model the pattern again without a fail state

modes.title: Shape Cargo
modes.skill: extend color-plus-shape AB, AAB, ABB, and ABC patterns

modes.title: Move & Sound
modes.skill: extend and physically act out clap, stomp, tap, and shake patterns

modes.title: My Train
modes.skill: author, revise, save, and replay a self-chosen five-wagon sequence
